newsitem.title: HONG KONG: New World Infra sets US$500 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: New World Infra sets US$500 mln loan.

text.p: An arranger group is being formed for New World Infrastructure's US$500 million term loan facility, bankers said on Tuesday.
The facility has a final maturity of five years. The deal is structured as a revolving credit for the first 30 months and then converts to a term loan for the remainder of its life.
Repayment is in bullet form. The loan is on an unsecured basis.
It pays an interest margin of 85 basis points over the Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate.
HSBC Investment Bank Asia and Goldman Sachs are the mandated arrangers. Each member of the expanded arranger group is invited to underwrite US$30 million, bankers said.
Proceeds are to be used for general working capital.
